mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and 68-degree temperatures near the Verona Public Library, while the moon is currently in its third quarter phase.

In city news, the Verona Senior Center has launched a new tri-shaw bike program for seniors to enjoy the local trails. Also, the Recreation Department is currently hiring seasonal staff for various positions.
There is plenty to do today, including the Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia events. Tomorrow, look forward to Concerts in the Park and even more trivia.
In a note from the police department, on July 31, officers stopped a vehicle for equipment violations, which resulted in the driver being arrested for an O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is currently closed, but they will open their doors for you at 10 AM today.
